meta.title: Playground Welcome Landing Page
meta.description: Landing page for the WordPress Playground giving a quick overview of the features and capabilities of the platform.
meta.author: fellyph

steps.code:
<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
foreach ( array( 'post', 'page', 'attachment', 'revision', 'nav_menu_item' ) as $post_type ) {
$posts = get_posts( array('posts_per_page' => -1, 'post_type' => $post_type ) );
foreach ($posts as $post) wp_delete_post($post->ID, true);
}

<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$url=get_site_url();$post = get_page_by_title('Hello from Playground!', OBJECT);
if ( $post ) {
	$search = $url . '/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/cover-image-playground-2.webp';
	$replace = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WordPress/blueprints/refs/heads/trunk/blueprints/welcome/assets/imgs/cover-image-playground-2.webp';
	$content = str_replace($search, $replace, $post->post_content);
	if ( $content !== $post->post_content ) {
		wp_update_post([
			'ID' => $post->ID,
			'post_content' => $content,
		]);
		clean_post_cache($post->ID);
	}
}
